en.headline: Kai Tak Hospital begins phased opening from 5 October
en.dek: The Family Medicine Integrated Centre will open first, with specialist outpatient and oncology services transferring from Queen Elizabeth Hospital in stages.
body: The Hospital Authority said Kai Tak Hospital will commence services in phases starting on 5 October, beginning with the Family Medicine Integrated Centre on the first floor of the Specialist Out-patient Clinic Block.

The centre will initially offer about 250 family medicine clinic quotas each day. Patients with episodic illnesses can book appointments through the HA Go mobile app or the telephone booking system from the morning of 4 October.

Specialist outpatient services of the Departments of Medicine, Surgery, Neurosurgery and Clinical Oncology at Queen Elizabeth Hospital will transfer in batches from late October. Allied health services, diagnostic imaging, pathology, pharmacy and day services for oncology and obstetrics and gynaecology will also roll out gradually during the month.

Kai Tak Hospital, located at 2-3 Shing Cheong Road in Kowloon Bay, is Hong Kong’s largest public hospital by floor area and planned bed capacity. Full inpatient, surgical and accident and emergency services are scheduled for 2028 as the second phase, when it will serve as the flagship hospital of the Kowloon Central Cluster covering about 1.8 million residents.

zh.headline: 啟德醫院10月5日起分階段投入服務
zh.dek: 家庭醫學綜合中心率先開診，專科門診及腫瘤科服務將由伊利沙伯醫院分批轉移。
body: 醫院管理局表示，啟德醫院將於10月5日起分階段投入服務，首先開放專科門診大樓一樓的家庭醫學綜合中心。
中心初期每日提供約250個家庭醫學診所名額。偶發性疾病病人可由10月4日早上起，透過醫管局手機應用程式「HA Go」或電話預約系統預約。
伊利沙伯醫院內科、外科、神經外科及臨床腫瘤科的專科門診服務，將由10月下旬起分批轉移至啟德醫院。專職醫療、診斷及介入放射、病理、藥劑，以及臨床腫瘤科和婦產科的日間服務，亦會於10月內逐步展開。
啟德醫院位於九龍灣承昌道2至3號，是本港樓面面積及計劃病牀數目最大的公立醫院。住院、手術及急症室服務定於2028年第二階段投入，屆時將成為九龍中聯網旗艦醫院，服務約180萬人口。
